fresh.title: Empty first launch and game creation
steps: Confirm Home has no recent games.
Create a quick game; select e2 twice, then play e2-e4.
Open Custom New Game; try empty/negative time and a missing required engine.

play.title: Multiple games, captures, game results and controls
steps: In play-opening play g1-f3; check board, turn, captures and history together.
Switch to play-mate and play d8-h4 for checkmate; inspect play-drawn and play-resigned.
Offer/accept/reject a draw, resign, take back and change a player in play-opening, resetting between destructive branches.
Switch between tabs, close all but one, then navigate to /game/missing-game.

history.title: Mainline history, variations and takeback permissions
steps: Expand the alternatives after e4/e5 in history-allowed and select each branch.
Return to the e4/e5 node and play f1-c4; check the historical rewrite confirmation and resulting mainline.
Repeat in history-blocked; verify the live continuation is preserved.
Enter in-game analysis, explore a move and exit; verify live position/clocks resume and board editing stays unavailable.

setup.title: Free analysis, board editing and starting from setup
steps: Explore setup-analysis without moving a live game.
In setup-board, add/remove pieces with the palette, clear/reset the board and leave editing.
Start a game from setup; inspect player, clock and live-analysis options and retained position.

promotion.title: White/black promotion, capture promotion and cancellation
steps: In promotion-white play a7-a8; cancel the chooser and verify no move was committed.
Repeat and choose each piece with a reset between choices; also try a7-b8 capture promotion.
In promotion-black repeat with h2-h1 and h2-g1.

analysis.title: Two scripted engines, three PVs and suggestion permissions
steps: Expand both engines in analysis-free; inspect three PVs, collapse/reopen and click a suggestion.
Compare analysis-score-only with analysis-live-moves: live-game move suggestions should follow each preference.
Add/remove engines; assign Journey unavailable to exercise engine failure while retaining the other seat.
Change a player to Journey A and make a local move to exercise the UCI player response.

clocks.title: Paused increment game and two short timeout games
steps: Resume clocks-increment and play g1-f3; verify a two-second increment and the active colour.
Open Settings and return; compare automatic menu pause with a manual pause.
Resume clocks-timeout-a, wait three seconds and dismiss its result; switch to clocks-timeout-b and repeat without reloading.

saves.title: Autosaves, named saves, recent games, import/export and deletion
steps: Inspect save-library and save-other, their autosaves and named saves; select, load, overwrite and delete entries.
Return Home and reopen a recent game.
Import uses imports/valid.json by default; use chooseImport() for corrupt/version/duplicate-ID fixtures or cancellation.
Export a game, then inspect its JSON using readFile('exports/<name>.json').
Make moves and inspect auto.json for move-count autosave; reset and repeat a close/save flow against the existing autosave.

settings.title: Prefilled engine inventory, appearance and dirty settings
steps: Inspect dark theme, black orientation and engine profiles A/B/unavailable.
Edit/apply/reset appearance and verify changes without restart.
Rename/remove/add an engine, apply, then open Custom New Game or Change Player and check the inventory.
Leave an unsaved settings edit through Return, tabs and browser Back; check save/discard prompts.

recovery.title: Corrupt settings/layout, missing game and unsupported game version
steps: Confirm the app remains usable with corrupt settings/layout and unavailable active game.
Verify recovery-valid is restored while recovery-broken and recovery-missing are removed from the open session.
Check the fallback route and recoverable warning; use reset() to repeat startup.
